name: Simple Permit
description: Single-trade mechanical, electrical, or plumbing permit with no plan review; often issued instantly to a licensed contractor, about 2 business days for an owner-builder.

name: No-Plan Building Permit
description: Like-for-like repair or replacement on an already-finaled structure (IB-203); combo permit or single-trade, about 10 business days for the historic/pre-construction check.

name: Building Permit with Plans
description: Required when a project moves walls, adds square footage, or involves major plumbing/electrical work. Fee is a valuation-based inspection fee (IB-101) plus a plan-check fee (IB-501, roughly 65-85% of the permit fee, not modeled separately here).

name: Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)
description: New or converted accessory dwelling unit; total permit and impact fees typically run $6,000-$20,000. Units under 750 sq ft are exempt from development impact fees.

name: Solar PV (Residential)
description: Rooftop solar photovoltaic system on a single-family home or duplex; qualifying systems (<=38.4kW AC) use SolarApp+ for 1-5 day instant plan review; manual review takes 10-21 days.

name: Tenant Improvement (Commercial)
description: Interior build-out of an existing commercial space; projects under 20,000 sq ft with no plumbing/stair/occupancy change may qualify for the IB-150 fast track (as fast as same-day).

name: Sign Permit
description: Permit for a new or replacement business sign; requires a vicinity map, dimensions, and setbacks (IB-501/IB-111). Electrical or high-rise signs also require inspection.

name: Grading Permit
description: Permit for earthwork, cut/fill, or drainage grading; fee is based on valuation or cubic-yard quantity.

name: Demolition/Removal
description: Permit to demolish or remove a structure, in part or in full; modest flat or valuation-based fee.

name: Special Event Permit
description: Required to host a permitted event on public property or with street closures. $341 base application fee if filed at least 60 days before the event, plus $80/business day for late filings and separate sub-permit fees (street closure, park use, amplified sound, alcohol, Police/Fire staffing).
